title: Transfer - Batch Scan Weight Triage
goal: Process a directory of noisy binary STL scans, compute the main-part mass for each file from attribute-coded material IDs and a reference table, and output the heaviest acceptable part together with a ranked batch summary.
skillBenefitRationale: The same mesh-analysis skill is still central, but it is transferred to repeated multi-file triage, testing whether binary parsing, debris filtering, and attribute extraction generalize beyond a single scan.
